The selected agency will be responsible for th e following: (i) Scope: To plan and conduct a 2–3 days residential outbound training programme for the students, focusing on experiential learning through outd oor activities, adventure exercises, camp games, and team-building activities. (ii) Deliverables: The agency shall provide a structured programme schedule, safe travel arrangement, suitable venue for program, comfort stay arr angement, experienced facilitators, and necessary arrangements for conducting outdoor activities and team-building exercises for the participants and the officials during batch wise schedule as per the period mentioned below in the departments table. Deliverables shall include successful execution of the residential programme, student participation records, group assignments, reflection and feed back sessions, photographic documentation, and a comprehensive completion report highlighting activities conducted, learning outcomes, student f eedback, and recommendations.

(iii) The basic requirements to successfully conduct the program includes following: a. Travel Arrangement: A safe travel arrangement (Deluxe/luxury Bus) from NIFT Patna Campus to the Destination Places b. Accommodation: At a reputed hotel/resort with necessary amenities. c. Meals: Everyday provision of Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, and Evening refreshments. d. Training & Activities: Adventure activities, leadership workshops and ice breaking sessions on all three days. e. Logistics Support: Safety measures/ support, medical assistance/ first aid kits, and on-site coordinators. f. Photography & Documentation: Capturing key moments and providing a detailed report.
